box-breathing-round-one: Let's begin. Breathe in... two... three... four. Hold... two... three... four. Breathe out... two... three... four. Hold... two... three... four.
box-breathing-round-two: Breathe in... two... three... four. Hold... two... three... four. Breathe out... two... three... four. Hold... two... three... four.
box-breathing-round-three: Breathe in... two... three... four. Hold... two... three... four. Breathe out... two... three... four. Hold... two... three... four. If the hold feels long, let it go a little shorter.
box-breathing-round-four: Breathe in... two... three... four. Hold... two... three... four. Breathe out... two... three... four. Hold... two... three... four. Last round.
legs-up-the-wall-breathe: Let your breath settle. Breathe in... two... three... four. Breathe out... two... three... four... five... six.
barefoot-breathing-box: Let's begin. Breathe in... two... three... four. Hold... two... three... four. Breathe out... two... three... four. Hold... two... three... four.
slow-breaths-four-six: Breathe in... two... three... four. Breathe out... two... three... four... five... six.
longer-out-breath-four-six: Same rhythm. Let the exhale come easy.
rest-box-breathing-settle: Breathe in... two... three... four. Hold... two... three... four. Breathe out... two... three... four. Hold... two... three... four.
box-breathing-settle: Sit or stand. Let your shoulders drop, away from your ears.
legs-up-the-wall-get-set-up: Hips close to the wall, legs resting up it. A cushion under your hips, if you like.
legs-up-the-wall-settle: Arms wide. Let the floor take your weight.
legs-up-the-wall-come-out-slowly: Bend your knees, roll to one side, and take your time sitting up.
barefoot-breathing-step-out: Barefoot on the porch, balcony, or by an open window.
two-minute-breath-pause-settle: Sit or stand. Let your shoulders drop.
craving-free-pause-stand-and-stretch: Stand up, and reach both arms overhead.
main-pilates-gentle-10-step-1-breath: Lie on your back, knees bent. Let your ribs widen as you breathe in... and soften as you breathe out. Nice and slow.
main-pilates-core-20-step-1-breath: Find the ribs-down, long-spine position you'll keep all session. Breathe in, wide through the ribs... and out, drawing the ribs gently down.
main-mobility-20-step-1-breath: Lie on your back and let the floor hold you. Breathe in slowly... and out, letting go a little more each time.
side-gym-carry-the-floor-step-3-breath: Set them down before your grip gives out. Shake out your hands, and take a few slow breaths.
dessert-favorite-playlist-groove-step-3-: One long, slow breath in... and a long, easy exhale to close.
dessert-park-bench-stretch-step-5-breath: Breathe in slowly, and listen to the park around you... Breathe out, and let it settle.
app-single-song-dance-step-4-breath: The song fades. Place your hands on your chest, and feel your heartbeat. Breathe in deep... and let it all go.
app-sunlight-strut-step-3-breath: Breathe in the crisp, open air for four... and out slowly for six. Let your shoulders soften. Keep that easy rhythm going.
app-power-explosions-step-3-breath: Hands on your hips. Take a deep breath in... and a slow breath out, as you pace in place.
app-power-explosions-step-5-breath: Stand tall, palms facing forward. Breathe in... and out. Feel that humming pulse through your body.
main-mindful-yoga-flow-step-1-breath: Sit cross-legged or kneel on your mat. Rest your hands on your lower belly. Breathe in for four... and out for four. Let your belly rise and fall under your hands.
spec-nature-immersion-step-4-breath: Take the descent with soft knees. Breathe in the forest air... and out slowly. Let the calm settle in with every step.
app-shake-out-five-step-1-breath: Stand comfortably. Let your shoulders drop away from your ears, and take one slow exhale.
app-shake-out-five-step-3-breath: Pause, and notice the warmth tingling in your hands and shoulders. Breathe easy.
app-shake-out-five-step-5-breath: Stay grounded through the soles of your feet, and breathe deeply.
app-power-pose-two-step-2-breath: Keep your chin level and your chest wide. Breathe in slowly into your belly... and out, slow and steady.
main-standing-strength-12-step-11-breath: Rest your hands on your belly. Breathe in through your nose... and out through your mouth.
app-cold-water-splash-step-2-breath: Splash cold water across your face, cheeks, and forehead. Feel that fresh, bright sensation.
app-cold-water-splash-step-3-breath: Pat your face dry, and take one long, slow exhale. Notice how you feel.
side-stretch-and-breathe-step-5-breath: Clasp your hands behind your back, or rest them on your hips. Open your chest, and breathe deeply.
app-jumping-jacks-two-step-3-breath: Hands on your hips, stand tall. Take two full breaths in... and out.
main-arms-shoulders-ten-step-3-breath: Shake out your hands, and take a few slow breaths.
main-push-ups-planks-fifteen-step-4-brea: Shake out your hands, and breathe.
side-gentle-reset-five-step-8-breath: Breathe in low, into the belly... then the middle... then high into the chest. And out, nice and slow.
side-morning-floor-five-step-5-breath: Stand, and breathe in through your nose... and out slowly.
side-gentle-core-five-step-1-breath: On your back, knees bent. Breathe in low and slow... and out.
side-gentle-core-five-step-5-breath: Lie back, hands on your belly. Slow breaths... in... and out.
side-ab-circuit-eight-step-5-breath: Lie back, and shake out your arms. Let your breath settle.
main-shoulders-core-thirty-step-10-breat: Lie on your back, and breathe.
main-shoulders-core-thirty-step-14-breat: Lie back, and let your arms fall open. Breathe easy.
main-bed-yoga-ten-step-1-breath: Lie on your back, hands on your belly. Slow breaths in... and out. Let the bed hold you.
main-gentle-yoga-five-poses-step-1-breat: Sit comfortably. Breathe slowly... in... and out.
app-pilates-breath-pelvic-three-step-1-b: On your back, knees bent, hands on your lower ribs. Breathe into your hands... and let the ribs soften as you exhale.
side-pilates-hundred-five-step-1-breath: On your back, knees bent. Breathe into your lower ribs... and out.
main-pilates-head-down-fifteen-step-11-b: Lie on your back, and breathe slowly.
main-pilates-classic-fifteen-step-11-bre: Sit or lie, and breathe slowly.
